newsitem.title: MEXICO: Five Mexican ports closed due to weather - gov't.
newsitem.headline: Five Mexican ports closed due to weather - gov't.

text.p: Four ports on the Mexican Pacific coast and another port on the Gulf of Mexico coast were closed on Tuesday due to bad weather, the Communications and Transport Ministry said.

The ports of Manzanillo, Acapulco, Salina Cruz and Puerto Madero on the Pacific coast were closed, the ministry said in a statement. It said it had issued an alert for the coastal states of Colima, Michoacan and Guerrero.
The port of Coatzacoalcos on the Gulf coast was also closed.

The statement said tropical storm Hernan was located off the Mexican Pacific coast moving west-northwest. As of 8:00 a.m. local time (1300 GMT), the storm was located 246 miles (396 km) south of the Pacific port of Lazaro Cardenas. It had sustained winds of 35 knots, the statement said.
Hernan was expected to strengthen during the day and be located at Latitude 14.3 degrees North and Longitude 104.1 degrees West at noon local time (1700 GMT).
